subject: Term architecture and burst onboarding plan
messages:
From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dan Li <dan.li@acme-corp.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning: term options + burst capacity

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. Acme's leadership wants to get renewal structure nailed down by end of month. Two asks from our side: a) term architecture options (1yr vs 2yr vs 3yr) with straightforward pricing for committed vs burst usage; b) a defined onboarding "burst" to cover model retraining and initial ingestion (we expect a two-week spike).

High-level context: our usage baseline is ~50M tokens/mo, but we expect a ramp to 200M tokens/mo within the first 9 months post-renewal as additional teams onboard. Procurement (cc'd Dan) also needs an outline of invoice cadence and auto-renew language options.

Can you share a short matrix with: committed volumes, burst bucket sizes, co-term vs staggered options, and any incentives for multi-year? Ideally a one-page matrix + an SOW draft would make legal/procurement reviews much faster.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

—Emily
Emily Stone
Head of AI Programs, Acme Corporation
emily.stone@acme-corp.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: term options + burst capacity

Emily — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a concise term matrix and a draft SOW to get the conversation moving. High-level proposal below; see attachments for numbers and sample clauses.

Proposal (summary)
- Baseline options: 1yr (flexible, no prepay), 2yr (10% effective discount with annualized billing), 3yr (15% discount with option to prepay year 1 for additional 5% rebate).
- Ramp schedule: agreed staged ramps at months 0, 3, 6, and 9 (e.g., 50M -> 100M -> 150M -> 200M). Credits can be frontloaded if you want faster access to capacity.
- Burst bucket: one-time onboarding burst (configurable) sized to cover two weeks of peak traffic; billed separately as a capped reserve that you can draw from.
- Co-terming: we recommend co-terming to Acme's fiscal year (Jun 30) to simplify renewals; alternative is anniversary-based for unit-tracking customers.
- Auto-renew: default is auto-renew with 60-day opt-out; procurement can request a manual renewal option (no auto-renew) if required.

Action items I propose:
1) Confirm preferred term (1/2/3yr) + whether you'd like prepay for year-1 incentive.
2) Confirm burst size (we suggested a conservative 60M token bucket in the attached matrix).
3) Legal/procurement redlines on SOW/renewal language.

Attaching: renewal_term_matrix.xlsx (term/pricing matrix), SOW_v1.pdf (sample SOW).

If helpful, Marissa can run through the discount ladder and Priya can scope onboarding timelines. Happy to schedule a 30-min alignment later this week.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@acme-corp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-16T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: term options + burst capacity

+1 on Karthik's notes. Quick add from discounts/structure perspective:
- If Acme commits to a 3-year term we can structure the ramp as a staged unlock with a 12-month price guarantee and a step-down for incremental tokens beyond committed tiers (effectively smoothing unit cost).
- We can offer a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to 8% of the first-year committed spend if you choose to co-term and prepay year 1.

Need one data point from your side though: anticipated peak Q after onboarding (daily tokens). That will determine the size of the burst bucket and whether we recommend a larger reserved pool vs on-demand bursts.

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Dan Li <dan.li@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Emily Stone <emily.stone@acme-corp.com>
Cc: legal@acme-corp.com
Date: 2028-06-18T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: term options + burst capacity

Karthik/Emily — procurement side here. A few specific asks before we can route to finance/legal: 
1) Invoice cadence options: monthly vs quarterly vs annual prepay (need sample invoice language).
2) Cancellation/termination: can you provide an explicit opt-out window and termination liability cap for multi-year?
3) Auto-renew: legal prefers opt-in auto-renew (i.e., renewal requires affirmative acceptance) — is Redwood able to accommodate for Enterprise deals?

Also attaching the PO template our finance team requires (internal). Please send a version of the SOW that maps costs to ledger lines we can consume.

Thanks,
Dan Li
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corporation
dan.li@acme-corp.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@acme-corp.com>, Dan Li <dan.li@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-22T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: term options + burst capacity

Thanks everyone — wanted to summarize agreed path so we have a single source of truth and clear next steps.

Agreement (summary of today's alignment)
- Term: move forward with a 2-year term with an option to extend to 3 years at preserved rates after year 1.
- Ramp: staged unlock at months 0/3/6/9 (50M -> 100M -> 150M -> 200M).
- Burst onboarding: one-time 60M token burst bucket to be provisioned at onboarding and billed as a capped reserve; overages billed monthly.
- Co-term: co-term to Acme fiscal year (Jun 30) as recommended.
- Auto-renew: for Enterprise we will present manual renewal (no automatic opt-in) to Acme legal; default commercial offering still supports auto-renew but we'll follow Acme preference for this deal.
- Invoice cadence: monthly invoices for committed capacity + itemized burst/overage lines. Monica will support mapping to ledger lines for your PO template.

Action items
1) Karthik/Marissa: deliver revised SOW that maps to Acme's PO and includes the termination cap and explicit opt-out window (ETA: 2028-06-24).
2) Priya: provide onboarding timeline and runbook for the two-week burst event (ETA: 2028-06-25).
3) Monica: provide sample invoice stub and ledger mapping (ETA: 2028-06-24).
4) Emily/Dan: confirm internal approval on the 60M burst and co-term direction.

I'll also send a DocuSign envelope for the SOW once we incorporate Dan's PO mapping — placeholder link attached.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
